name: Crown of the Earth
summary: At the Oracle Glade, Corithras Moonrage sends you to gather water from Teldrassil’s sacred moonwell. The journey reveals the truth behind the World Tree’s creation.

sections.title: The Oracle Glade
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage sends you northwest across Teldrassil to the Oracle Glade. Beneath the Oracle Tree’s great boughs lies the first and most powerful moonwell raised on the island. You draw water into an Amethyst Phial from its sacred pool. The moonwell is the sanctuary where druids and the tree itself watch over the health of their new homeland.

sections.title: The Denied Blessing
sections.body: When you return the phial to Dolanaar, Corithras tells you what went wrong with Archdruid Fandral Staghelm’s design. After Nordrassil was sacrificed at Mount Hyjal, Staghelm planted Teldrassil to restore night elf immortality and asked the Dragon Aspects to bless it. Nozdormu the Timeless One refused, rebuking Staghelm for his arrogance. Queen Alexstrasza also withheld her blessing, the Aspect of Life’s gift. Without it, Teldrassil’s growth became volatile and imperfect, leaving the tree vulnerable to deep corruption.

faq.q: Where is the Oracle Glade moonwell located?
faq.answer: The Oracle Glade moonwell lies in northwestern Teldrassil, beneath the great boughs of the Oracle Tree and directly north of the main road to Darnassus.
Corithras Moonrage is a night elf keeper stationed at Dolanaar. He guides young defenders across Teldrassil to sample its moonwells and teaches the history of the tree’s flawed beginnings.

faq.q: Did Teldrassil restore night elf immortality?
faq.answer: No. Teldrassil gave the night elves a new home, but their immortality was not restored after Nordrassil’s sacrifice during the Third War.

faq.q: What is the purpose of collecting water from the Oracle Glade?
faq.answer: The moonwell beneath the Oracle Tree is the island’s first and most powerful. Its water lets Corithras assess Teldrassil’s spiritual and natural health.

angles.text: As a night elf, you hear of your people’s hopes for Teldrassil after Nordrassil’s sacrifice during the Third War.
As a druid, you see the divide between Fandral Staghelm’s forceful ambitions and the natural balance traditionally kept by Malfurion Stormrage.
As an Alliance member, you learn why blight and creature madness trouble Teldrassil, the Alliance’s newest capital territory.
